summary: Frontend-only smoke + verification of new Business Continuity section (#continuity) and updated CTA styles (navbar 'Napisz do nas', hero primary 'Zaplanuj konsultację'). All acceptance criteria pass: section DOM order (tape-library < continuity < sectors), light background #F8FAFA, PDU device with bank-a/bank-b having 6 outlets each, digital display shows 230 V / 12.4 A / LOAD 62%, 4 continuity value cards, CTA href='#contact' scrolls to contact, navbar switches to sc-nav--light with black logo when #continuity is centered, nav-cta and hero-cta-primary have linear-gradient(135deg,#06FFE0->#00B8D4) with border-radius 10px, font-weight 700, text-transform none, color rgb(0,27,32) — matching contact submit (sc-chat-send) style. Bilingual toggle produces 'Business continuity' / 'Power that never fails.' in EN. No console errors, no horizontal overflow on 1920 or 390. Regression P0 check on switch labels (6 present).
critical_code_review_comments: Two elements in ContactSection.jsx carry data-testid="contact-submit" (fallback form) but the default AI-Assistant mode renders the submit button with data-testid="ai-send-turn" instead. This is not a bug (styles are identical via .sc-chat-send class), but the initial DOM has no contact-submit — tests targeting that selector will fail unless the classic form tab is activated first. Consider adding data-testid="contact-submit" to the visible ai-send-turn button as well, or renaming for consistency.
App.css is 6163 lines — consider splitting into modular per-section stylesheets to keep files under 700 lines.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 focused solely on the new #continuity section + CTA restyle. All requirements met. Note: data-testid=contact-submit is on the fallback classic form only; the default AI mode uses ai-send-turn — both share the .sc-chat-send visual style which matches nav-cta and hero-cta-primary. No regressions detected on hero, switch section, or navbar behavior.
